title: Given only a pointer/reference to a node to be deleted in a singly linked list, how do you delete it?
constraints: The given node is not the tail
inputFormat:
Implement givenOnlyAPointerReferenceToANodeToBeDeletedInASinglyLinkedListHowDoYouDeleteIt(node). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Linked lists use value arrays. The editor passes nodes with val and next properties; [] becomes null.
The fixture supplies a list and a zero-based nodeIndex. The editor passes only the selected non-tail node to your function.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
Returned list heads are displayed as value arrays; a null head is [].
